# Calibration Status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CalibrationStatus`](gmeow-CalibrationStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CalibrationStatus>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/metacognition`](../../slices/metacognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The qualitative fit between an agent's avowed confidence and its actual accuracy — a closed value vocabulary: [`gmeow:wellCalibrated`](../individuals/gmeow-wellCalibrated.md) (confidence tracks accuracy), [`gmeow:overconfident`](../individuals/gmeow-overconfident.md) (confidence exceeds accuracy — the Dunning–Kruger pole), and [`gmeow:underconfident`](../individuals/gmeow-underconfident.md) (accuracy exceeds confidence — the impostor pole). Its members are individuals, never subclasses. The numeric magnitude of the gap is the solver-layer [`gmeow:calibrationError`](../properties/gmeow-calibrationError.md); this is the qualitative reading.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CalibrationStatus`](gmeow-CalibrationStatus.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the qualitative calibration of a [`gmeow:MetacognitiveState`](gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md) — well-calibrated, over-, or under-confident — when the direction of the confidence/accuracy gap is what consumers route on.

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing it to add a status (the vocabulary is closed and its members are individuals) and avoid using it to carry the numeric error magnitude (that is the solver-layer [`gmeow:calibrationError`](../properties/gmeow-calibrationError.md), not a value individual).

### How to use

- Reference the three seeded [`gmeow:CalibrationStatus`](gmeow-CalibrationStatus.md) individuals from a [`gmeow:MetacognitiveState`](gmeow-MetacognitiveState.md) via [`gmeow:calibration`](../properties/gmeow-calibration.md); carry the numeric Brier-style gap, when computed, as a [`gmeow:calibrationError`](../properties/gmeow-calibrationError.md) annotation on the asserting statement.

### Examples

- ex:samDoubtsOwnGrasp [`gmeow:calibration`](../properties/gmeow-calibration.md) [`gmeow:overconfident`](../individuals/gmeow-overconfident.md).
